International Jury used tracking by Vakaros Race Sense as an evidence at all hearings before hearing 11.
During the hearing of case no. 11 International Jury didn't take into account tracking evidence by Vakaros Race Sense System.
After the decision was made International Jury looked at the Vakaros Race Sense tracking.
Evidence by the Vakaros Race Sense system for case no. 11 could indicate that facts found were wrong.
